sentinel_note: Overflowed ('****') AMBER MBAR-block energy fields substituted with this sentinel instead of dropping the frame; verified physically appropriate (astronomically unfavorable state, ~0 Boltzmann weight) and verified NOT the cause of the docked_bhd2 anomaly (magnitude-swap test: 1e15 vs 1e6 gave a bit-identical result).
reduced_potential_convention: u_nk supplied to MBAR.fit() is raw AMBER energy (kcal/mol, verified against EPtot) divided by kBT before fitting; output delta_f_/d_delta_f_ multiplied by kBT for kcal/mol reporting.
forward_backward_convention: forward[i] uses the FIRST i/10 fraction of each window's (post-equilibration) samples; backward[i] uses the LAST i/10 fraction. Compared at the 90% fraction (first-90% vs last-90%, 80% data overlap) since the 100% point is trivially identical for both directions.
docked_bhd2_pipeline: VALIDATED pipeline: uniform stride (all 12 windows reduced by the same factor), not per-window independent statistical-inefficiency-based decorrelation. The forensic audit (docked_bhd2_audit/) identified per-window independent decorrelation as the cause of an ill-conditioned full 12-state solve for this system specifically (window 1's long correlation time reduced its N_k to 62 vs thousands for its neighbors). Uniform stride=10 was adopted as the validated default; results were cross-checked at stride 5, 10, 20, 40, all consistent within ~20 kcal/mol of each other on a ~3218 kcal/mol scale.
other_7_systems_pipeline: alchemlyb.convergence-style forward/backward with per-window independent decorrelation (pymbar statistical_inefficiency + subsample_correlated_data) -- validated, no anomalies found for these 7 systems.
convergence_criterion: Relative forward/backward difference at the 90% trajectory fraction, as a percentage of the total free energy: <=0.5% CONVERGED, 0.5-1.5% BORDERLINE, >1.5% NOT CONVERGED. NOTE: the raw z-score (difference / analytic MBAR uncertainty) was computed but NOT used as the deciding criterion -- analytic uncertainty at fixed fractions is sub-kcal/mol and produces z-scores of 3-44 purely from a tight denominator, not from genuinely large absolute differences (confirmed for docked_bhd2: bootstrap uncertainty of 8.05 kcal/mol is 11x the analytic 0.72 kcal/mol).
